purpose: Consolidate all 5 full-matrix judge sweeps (v11/v2/v3/v4/v5) into a single reference table for C3 v3 conclusions.
method: Each judge ran independently on the same 36 R4 runs (9 configs × 2 domains × 2 seeds). Pass rates extracted from items[].verdict. Config-level means computed over 4 runs per config.

judge_verdicts.v11_specificity_fingerprint: VALIDATED. Sham separated (gap -0.233), no over-triggering, A-full healthy (0.775). The 10-iteration endpoint.
judge_verdicts.v2_density_audit: USABLE. No sham separation (sham 0.823 near A-full 0.868) but no over-triggering. Good complementary density signal.
judge_verdicts.v3_anti_template: FAIL. Sham separated (-0.477) but 75% false-positive rate on real runs. Over-kills local-reasoning domain.
judge_verdicts.v4_anti_spin: FAIL. Sham not separated (0.699 > A-full 0.613). Fabricated numbers in sham defeat zero-numeric-claims condition.
judge_verdicts.v5_plan_discovery: FAIL. Over-correction: entire field at ≤0.053. Legitimate planning deliverables killed.
judge_verdicts.J1-strict-v6 (prepared-plan exception): PARTIAL — fixes v5 over-correction (A-full 0.810 vs v5's 0.053) but sham NOT cleanly separated (mean gap -0.141 but paired diffs inconsistent: D1a 0.0, D1b -0.524, D2a +0.262, D2b -0.300). Freeze effect confirmed (B-nofreeze rank 1/9). Transitional rubric validating design trajectory.

robust_findings.freeze_negative_effect: B-nofreeze rank 1/9 under v11, v2, v3, v4, v6 (5/5 usable judges). Most robust finding in C3 v3 matrix. v5 too noisy to confirm (field-zeroed).
robust_findings.noevidence_high_score: B-noevidence highest or near-highest under v11 (0.906, rank 1), v2 (0.950, rank 1), v4 (0.815, rank 1). Dropped to rank 6 only under v3 (anti-template artifact). Judge-dependent inversion confirmed.
robust_findings.sham_separation: Only v11 achieves clean sham separation without side effects. v3 separates but at unacceptable FP cost (75% over-trigger). v4 fails (sham above A-full). v5 'separates' by killing everything. v6 partial (mean gap -0.141 but cell-level inconsistent).

conclusion: The 6-judge panel confirms: (1) rubric text drives independent item extraction; (2) v11 specificity-fingerprint is the validated endpoint of the 10-iteration design process; (3) freeze negative effect is the most robust finding (5/5 usable judges agree); (4) B-noevidence high score is judge-dependent; (5) for future runs, report v11 as primary + v2 as complementary density probe. v6 validates the design trajectory (v5→v6→...→v11) but is not production-ready.
